Author: Anomek, Noir Yamato
Name: NoirMech
Punchline: AnoMech with LPDU strats for TOP P2, P3, P4, P5 Delta and P6, and a pause. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds EU LPDU strats for TOP P2 Party Synergy, TOP P3 Intermission, P3 Hello World, P3 Monitors, P4 Blue Screen, P5 Delta, P6 Exasquares/Dive, P6 Exaflares/WC1, P6 Exasquares/WC2, P6 Exaflares/Dive and P6 Cosmo Meteor, and a pause for studying mechanics mid-run. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Changelog: TOP P6: an [LPDU] Light PF strat for Exasquares/WC2 under the EU button, now the default, and four new scenarios with LPDU strats: Exasquares/Dive, Exaflares/WC1, Exaflares/Dive and Cosmo Meteor. With Require tank mitigation on, Cosmo Memory needs a tank limit break 3. Multiplayer Exasquares/WC2 needs everyone on this version.
